title: Installation Jobs: Released and Far-Moved Crew Dates in Late Reschedule Pricing
content:
**Scheduling desk note — what a customer reschedule did with the crew date (Installation Jobs)**

What a customer reschedule on an **Installation Jobs** record did with the crew date counts toward the late reschedule fee billed for it. The fee for the reschedule being charged is multiplied by a release factor:

| What the reschedule did with the crew date | Release factor |
|---|---|
| released the crew date with no new date | 1.2 |
| moved the crew date to a new date more than 21 days after the date it moved | 1.1 |
| moved the crew date by 21 days or fewer | one |

The reschedule considered is the most recent customer reschedule recorded on the job, the reschedule being charged. The distance of a move is counted in calendar days from the crew date being moved to the new crew date on that reschedule record.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Crew date moved | New crew date | Days between | Release factor |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 June | 24 June | 21 | one |
| 3 June | 25 June | 22 | 1.1 |
| 3 June | none | — | 1.2 |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A late reschedule fee figure of 175.00 is being priced for a customer reschedule that released the crew date and left the job waiting for a new date. The release factor is 1.2, giving 210.00.
